description: Schematic composite of three square boxes drawn side by side, illustrating the positions of ideal rolling-texture components in Euler-angle (ODF) space. At the top-left of the first box are the coordinate axes: a horizontal arrow labelled φ1 and a downward vertical arrow labelled Φ. The boxes are labelled beneath as φ2 = 0°, φ2 = 45° and φ2 = 65°. The φ2 = 0° box has open squares at its four corners, an open square labelled C near the top-left, a filled diamond labelled G on the left edge, an open diamond labelled B in the interior, a hexagon labelled RtG on the right edge, and a dashed horizontal line with an arrow labelled α-fiber pointing from G toward RtG. The φ2 = 45° box carries the label τ-fiber with a rightward arrow along its top edge and γ-fiber with a downward arrow meeting a dashed horizontal line that bears E (open triangles) and F (filled triangles); further markers are RtG hexagon bottom-left, B open diamond bottom-middle, G filled diamond bottom-right, and Cu and CuT triangles stacked on the right edge. The φ2 = 65° box is empty except for the letters S and a single open circle. Marker shapes are shared across panels (open diamond = B, filled diamond = G, hexagon = RtG, triangles = Cu/CuT), fixing the ideal component orientations used by the paper's ODF sections.

observations.observation: The figure is a three-panel schematic of ODF sections labelled φ2 = 0°, φ2 = 45° and φ2 = 65° (left to right).
Coordinate axes are drawn only above the left panel: a horizontal arrow labelled φ1 and a downward vertical arrow labelled Φ.
In the φ2 = 0° section, the α-fiber is drawn as a dashed horizontal line with an arrow labelled 'α-fiber' pointing from the G marker toward the RtG marker.

The φ2 = 0° section contains an open square labelled C near the top-left corner and open squares at all four corners, plus a filled diamond labelled G, an open diamond labelled B and a hexagon labelled RtG.

The φ2 = 45° section labels the τ-fiber with a rightward arrow along the top edge and the γ-fiber with a downward arrow that meets a horizontal dashed line marked by E (open triangles) and F (filled triangles).
In the φ2 = 45° section the remaining markers are RtG (hexagon, bottom-left), B (open diamond, bottom-middle), G (filled diamond, bottom-right) and Cu and CuT (triangles stacked on the right edge).
The φ2 = 65° section is an empty square containing only the label S and one open circle marker.
No numeric values, intensities, scale bars or colour scales are printed anywhere in the figure; only ideal orientation positions and axis/section labels are shown.
The caption describes the figure as a 'Schematic illustration of the main texture components in the present investigation'.
'Fig. 7 and Table 1 illustrate the ideal orientations of the texture component observed in the present work.'
The citing text states the initial texture before cold rolling was almost random, reflected by the inverse pole figure in Fig. 2(a), and that ODF sections of φ2 = 0°, 45°, 65° are shown in Fig. 8.
The citing text states the α-fiber texture monotonously increased up to 90% rolling reduction.

The citing text states that the {112}〈111〉 copper (Cu) and {123}〈111〉 S components (belonging to the β-fiber) increased at lower to medium rolling reductions and then decreased at higher strains, and that weak orientations near the γ-fiber were present at 90% rolling reduction.

subfigures.description: φ2 = 0° ODF section drawn as a square; open squares at the corners, open square C at top-left, filled diamond G on the left edge, open diamond B interior, hexagon RtG on the right edge; a dashed horizontal line with an arrow labelled α-fiber runs from G toward RtG. Outer axes φ1 (horizontal) and Φ (vertical, downward) are drawn above it.

Markers: RtG hexagon (bottom-left), B open diamond (bottom-middle), G filled diamond (bottom-right), plus Cu and CuT triangles on the right edge.
φ2 = 65° ODF section, an otherwise empty square containing only the label S and one open circle marker.
